definitions.gloss: close friend, good friend, being on good terms
definitions.explanation: Describes people who get along well and have a friendly, harmonious relationship. Also used as an adjective-like modifier meaning 'friendly' or 'close.'

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{仲良|なかよ}しだ。
{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仲良|なかよ}しだ。
examples.english: We've been close friends since childhood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧{仲良|なかよ}し⟦じゃない→じゃない：28483_janai⟧。
examples.english: Even though they're siblings, they don't get along at all.

notes:
USAGE: {仲良|なかよ}し has a warm, somewhat childlike or casual tone. It is very common in everyday speech, especially among women and children, and sounds softer than the more neutral ⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {仲良|なかよ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧ (a close friend)
- {仲良|なかよ}し⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧ (friend group, clique)
- ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仲良|なかよ}く→仲良い：29434_nakayoi⟧ (everyone getting along)

SIMILAR: ⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ is a more neutral, adult way to say "to be on good terms." {仲良|なかよ}し sounds more affectionate and informal.
